entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: A great port city and part-time capital of Kjeldor on Terisiare, ancestral holding of Darien's line; later renamed Argivia.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The kingdom whose capital Kjeld was.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Merchant city that took over as capital of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where Kjeld stands.

entities.name: Darien Kjeld
entities.description: King who ruled Kjeld, a descendant of Oriel Kjeldos.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: Led her people away from Storgard before its fall; died on the journey and is considered a founder of the nation.

entities.name: Zaraya
entities.description: Resident of Kjeld 500 years after its foundation.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Enemy fought by the Kjeldoran army.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Took the Staff of Ice Lords and gave it to Jaeuhl Carthalion.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Recipient of the Staff of Ice Lords.

entities.name: Staff of Ice Lords
entities.description: Staff atop the Winter Palace that repelled creatures.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion in which the city was destroyed utterly.

events.summary: Oriel Kjeldos leads her people away from Storgard before its fall and dies on the journey.
events.quote: Although she died on the journey, she is considered one of the nation's founders

events.summary: Kjeld remains capital until Krov takes over that position.
events.quote: remained the capital until the expanding merchant city of Krov took over that position

events.summary: The Kjeldoran army fights the Cult of Rimewind under King Darien Kjeld.
The city, renamed Argivia, is destroyed utterly in the Phyrexian Invasion and later rebuilt.
events.quote: It was destroyed utterly during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

relations.quote: Kjeld was ruled by King Darien Kjeld
taken by Freyalise and given to Jaeuhl Carthalion
